seo.title: StopCorn — Regain control of your habits, without judgment
seo.description: StopCorn is a free, private, open-source app that helps adults understand their pornography use, move through urges, and progress at their own pace.
seo.socialImageAlt: StopCorn logo on a soft green and cream background

hero.title: Understand your habits.
hero.titleHighlight: Take back control, at your pace.
hero.description: StopCorn helps adults who want to change their relationship with pornography. Notice what is happening, move through difficult moments, and see your progress — without an account, ads, or judgment.

mission.title: An honest tool in a world of closed and limited alternatives
mission.description: Many alternatives place their most useful tools behind a subscription or turn an intimate process into a product. StopCorn was created to offer accessible, discreet, and transparent support to anyone who feels they need it.
mission.quote: Progress is not a perfect streak. It grows as you understand your patterns and choose, a little more often, the action that is right for you.

free.title: Truly free
free.description: Useful features stay available without a subscription. Supporting the project is voluntary and unlocks no essential advantage.

private.title: Built to remain private
private.description: No StopCorn account, no tracking server, and no collection of sensitive content. Your entries remain locally on your phone.

kind.title: No guilt or shame
kind.description: The app shows trends without labels or punishment. A logged event never erases the effort you have already made.

features.title: Simple tools for the moments that matter
features.description: No miracle promises: practical cues to prepare, act, understand, and move forward.

urge.title: Move through an urge
urge.description: An urgent action that is immediately available, with guided breathing, a short delay, and strategies you selected in advance.

journal.title: A discreet journal
journal.description: Voluntarily note context, emotions, and a private thought without recording websites, searches, or viewed content.

progress.title: Nuanced progress
progress.description: Compare your starting point with recent trends: frequency, sense of control, intensity, and change over time.

checkIn.title: A short daily check-in
checkIn.description: Take a few seconds to step back from the day without turning self-observation into another burden.

plan.title: A plan that fits you
plan.description: Prepare realistic actions and bring the best option back to mind when the decision becomes more difficult.

harvest.title: Positive momentum
harvest.description: Positive actions grow a small symbolic harvest, with no ranking, competition, or punishing streak.

howItWorks.title: How does StopCorn work?
howItWorks.description: The app supports you through a short, voluntary loop. You always stay in control of what you enter.

baseline.title: Set a starting point
baseline.description: When you begin, choose your goal and estimate your recent frequency, sense of control, and perceived impact.

observe.title: Observe without judging
observe.description: Check-ins and the journal reveal contexts and trends without labeling each day as a success or failure.

act.title: Act in the moment
act.description: When an urge arises, open the urgent flow and follow a strategy you prepared while the decision was easier.

learn.title: Adjust gradually
learn.description: Compare your recent situation with your starting point, keep what helps, and adapt your plan over time.

howItWorks.note: StopCorn does not block websites or monitor your browsing. It is a voluntary self-observation and action tool.

privacy.title: What is intimate should stay that way
privacy.description: The app is local by default. It requires no StopCorn account and includes no advertising, audience analytics, or marketing tracker. Anonymous crash reports can be turned off in the settings.

noAccount.title: No account
noAccount.description: No StopCorn identity to create and no remote synchronization of your journal.

noTracking.title: No behavioral tracking
noTracking.description: The app contains no ads, audience measurement, or marketing profiling.

noExplicitData.title: No explicit content collected
noExplicitData.description: No URLs, browsing history, searches, screenshots, or network traffic are recorded.

privacy.policyLead: This policy describes the data handled by the StopCorn mobile app and by this website. It applies to the free app and its optional support mechanism.

overview.title: Controller and principles
overview.body: StopCorn is an open-source project published by Skyost. It follows a local-first approach: the tracking information you enter is used by the app on your device and is not sent to a StopCorn server.

mobileData.title: Mobile app data
mobileData.body: Your goal, check-ins, events, notes, strategies, and settings are stored locally. StopCorn never collects URLs, searches, screenshots, browsing history, contacts, or locations. You can voluntarily export your data or delete all data held by the app from its settings.

crashReports.title: Crash reports
crashReports.body: When StopCorn fails, an anonymous technical report can be sent through Sentry so the problem gets fixed. It contains the error, the version, and where in the app it happened. It never contains a goal, a check-in, an event, a note, or a value read from the local database, and navigation details are stripped of any identifier. Reporting is on by default and a switch in the app settings stops it completely.

websiteData.title: Website data
websiteData.body: This static website contains no advertising, audience analytics, or trackers. It only uses a functional cookie to remember your language choice. The hosting provider may retain standard technical logs, such as an IP address and request date, under its own operational and security rules.

supportPurchase.title: Optional support through RevenueCat
supportPurchase.body: StopCorn contacts RevenueCat only if you open the support page yourself: displaying the support card in Settings involves no network call. Once you have opened it, RevenueCat may process technical identifiers to check your support status, so an earlier purchase can still be acknowledged. When you provide support, RevenueCat and the App Store or Google Play also process the information needed for the purchase. StopCorn disables advertising features and does not use this information to track your habits. Support is voluntary, and your private notes are never sent with a purchase.

externalServices.title: External links and services
externalServices.body: Links to GitHub, app stores, and third-party pages open independent services. Their use is governed by their own terms and privacy policies. No content from your StopCorn journal is attached to these links.

choices.title: Your choices and rights
choices.body: You control the information you enter: export only starts when you request it, local data deletion is available in settings, and anonymous crash reports can be turned off there as well. If you have a question about this policy, you can open a public request on GitHub, taking care never to publish intimate information there.

faq.title: You may be wondering…
faq.description: The essentials about the app's role, limits, and model.

purpose.question: Who is StopCorn for?
purpose.answer: StopCorn is for adults who want to understand or change their pornography use, whatever its frequency. You do not need to describe yourself as addicted to use the app.

privacy.question: Does my data leave my phone?
privacy.answer: Goals, check-ins, events, notes, and strategies stay in the app's local database. Displaying Settings involves no network call: StopCorn contacts RevenueCat only once you have opened the support page yourself, and afterwards to acknowledge an earlier purchase. Making an optional purchase also involves your device's app store. If the app fails, an anonymous crash report can be sent so the problem gets fixed, and it can be turned off in the settings. No private note is associated with any of these operations.

blocking.question: Does StopCorn block websites or monitor my browsing?
blocking.answer: No. StopCorn installs no filter, VPN, or monitoring system. It does not know which websites you visit or what you search for. It helps you act voluntarily and observe only the information you choose to enter.

medical.question: Does the app replace a healthcare professional?
medical.answer: No. StopCorn is a self-observation and self-help tool; it is not a medical device, diagnosis, or treatment. If your situation causes distress or puts you in danger, contact a qualified professional or your country's emergency services.

price.question: Is StopCorn really free?
price.answer: Yes. Essential features are free and the code is open source. Optional financial support may be offered in the app, without reserving important features for people who pay.

support.question: How can I report a problem or suggest an improvement?
support.answer: The GitHub repository accepts bug reports and suggestions. Since those discussions are public, never share intimate notes, personal history, or other sensitive data in an issue.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.lead: By using StopCorn or this website, you agree to the terms below. They are intended to state the role and limits of a free, open-source project in plain language.

eligibility.title: Adults only
eligibility.body: StopCorn is intended for people aged 18 or older. By using the app, you confirm that you meet your country's age requirement for access to a tool that discusses pornography use.

purpose.title: Nature of the service
purpose.body: StopCorn provides self-observation, organization, and general information tools. The app is not a medical, psychological, or emergency service, makes no diagnosis, and guarantees no particular outcome.

responsibilities.title: Responsible use
responsibilities.body: You choose the information you enter and remain responsible for its backup and export, as well as for the security of your device. Do not use the project's public channels to publish personal or intimate information.

availability.title: Availability and warranties
availability.body: The project is provided free of charge and as is. We aim to maintain a reliable app, but cannot guarantee permanent availability, complete absence of errors, or suitability for a particular situation. To the extent permitted by law, you use it at your own responsibility.

externalServices.title: Third-party services and support
externalServices.body: App stores, RevenueCat, GitHub, and other linked sites apply their own terms. Any financial support is optional, processed by the relevant store, and subject to its payment, refund, and availability rules.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
changes.body: The app and these terms may change. The update date appears at the top of this section. Any material change will be presented with reasonable prominence on this website or in the app.
